page.layout: One page of text, with the running head at the top and the page number at the top right. The text runs in one column. Two verses are set in italic lines, then the commentary paragraphs follow. No marginal notes and no footnotes.

main_text.p: ra[?] prophetia de adventu Antichristi adventum Christi antegressuro, ab altera parte verf.3. ad verf.13. Posthæc Theffalonicenses confolatur contra metum defectionis ac seduftionis: simulq; hortatur eos ad constantiam in doctrina ab ipso acceptâ: quinetiam veram consolationem atque constantiam à Deo eis exoptat, ad finem usque capitis.

p.i: 1 Rogamus autem vos, fratres, per adventum Domini nostri Jesu Christi, & nostri in eum aggregationem,
2 Ne cito à mente dimoveamini, neque turbemini, neque per spiritum, neque per sermonem, neque per epistolam tanquam per nos scriptam, quasi instet dies illę Christi.

main_text.p: Rogamus] Hæc est epistolæ hujus pars tertia, in qua primum est admonitio: admonet enim ne aurem præbeant falsis doctoribus, qui conati sunt iis persuadere de die adventus Christi, quòd is instaret, arreptâ fortasse occasione ex iis quæ Apostol⁹[?] priori epistolâ docuit de Christi illo adventu secundo; ubi inter cætera, hæc habet cap.4.ɣ[?].17. Deinde nos vivi qui reliqui erimus, rapiemur simul cum iis in nubes, in occursum Domini in aëra. Ex his (ut videtur) cocluserunt[?], diem Domini instare, & viventibus adhuc iis qui in eâ ætate fuerunt superventurũ. Apostolus itaque eâ re cognitâ, monet sive rogat potiùs Theffalonicenses ne patiantur se abduci in hunc errorem & falsam opinionem. Primo versu habetur rogatio: est autem ea cum obtestatione gravi conjuncta: simul enim obtestatur & quasi adjurat eos per adventum illum Christi & nostri in eum aggregationem. Rogando itaque obtestatur & adjurat suo more. Vide 2. Cor.10.1. ubi ha-

page.notes: The first word of the page, "ra", is a fragment continuing from the previous page and is marked [?]. The superscript after "Apostol" is read as a contracted "us" (Apostolus). The reading "cap.4.ɣ.17" is uncertain, since the symbol after "4." could be a Greek letter or a mis-set v. "cocluserunt" is a doubtful reading of a word that looks like "cocluferunt" in the scan. The line ending "ha-" is a word broken at the line end and continues on the next page. No catchword is printed.
